case_review.decision: Accept the original paired-review gate for the stated model, sampler and32K quality protocol. Windows is one first-attempt case below the fresh Linux reference and equal atpass@3, and one case above the originalR9 baseline at both metrics. case_review.limits: One unseeded full150 run per arm. McNemar p=1.0 for fresh comparisons is not proof of equivalence. Mixed wins/losses are preserved; do not claim broad or distributional quality equivalence.
